newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sixteen criminals executed in southern China-paper.
newsitem.headline: Sixteen criminals executed in southern China-paper.

text.p: Authorities in the southern Chinese city of Guangzhou have executed 16 criminals, a Hong Kong newspaper reported on Thursday.

The 16, who were all convicted of violent crimes ranging from armed robbery to kidnapping, were executed on Wednesday shortly after their sentences were announceed in a Guangzhou court, the independent daily Ming Pao said.

China earlier this week announced the launch of the spring session of its "Strike Hard" campaign, the nation's biggest crackdown on crime. Thousands are believed to have been executed since the campaign began last April.
During the winter session from December to February, police cracked 380,000 crimes, including 145,000 major crimes, official media said.
